policy.host_role: load one image, transport arguments, forward receipts
policy.guest_role: all counts, interpolation, top-k, loss, context math

switching: No projection table switching. The byte, word, token and context layouts are resident together in one 32M-word VM; load(kind) only labels the caller focus.
note: One 256 MiB guest image holds all full projection tables and 20 context page slots with disjoint address ranges.
